blocks.title: Counted 3-leg pilot on the final conditionless campaign recipe
blocks.question: Do three counted conditionless single-turn 27B legs run end to end on the frozen campaign bytes (soak, G0 per leg, KM003C, close) inside their budgets?
blocks.block_definition: One span of three legs; counts toward the campaign only if the campaign ruling registers it as counted before it runs (RL-143 item 1 amendment requested).
blocks.notes: Waits for: Part C readout (RUN_STATE 315), the campaign ruling, the campaign runner (runner.kind cadence-legs-v1), final-byte gates. Throughput plan calendar: Sun 11-15.
